events.title: Tupac Shakur's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died from his injuries six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a legend. Remembering the enduring impact of Tupac Shakur today.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Death
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who redefined the electric guitar and left us far too soon. His music lives on.

events.title: The Beatles Release Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring the famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Still one of the most recognisable album covers and soundtracks of all time.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the legendary Chrissie Hynde, still rocking at 75! What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972, and celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when this changed everything? 25 years since the original iPod dropped and put '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible showmanship and voice of Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. Forever a legend.

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's Death
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed in New York City on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace and music continues to resonate globally.
